newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian noon rubber stable in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian noon rubber stable in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices were stable at midday on Wednesday in slow trading due to continued weak demand from key buyers in the United States, traders said.
"There have been no deals heard since last night due to weak New York demand. Prices are likely to stay weak the rest of the day," one trader in Jakarta said.
The trader said there were bids for July/August shipments at 46.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang, but no deals were heard.
Offer prices were at 46.25 fob Padang, at 46.50 fob Surabaya and at 46.00 fob Jambi and Pontianak.
